SEGMENT.RANGE.summary: Reads byte ranges from a segment of a volume.
SEGMENT.RANGE.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of ranges.

reply_schema.description: The bytes of each range, in request order.

arguments.name: segment-id
arguments.summary: The id of the segment to read from.

arguments.name: range
arguments.summary: One or more ranges to read.

arguments.name: position
arguments.summary: Byte offset of the range in the segment.
